statements.t: We expect revenue from legacy customers to continue to decline, including as a result of the planned wind-down of our legacy messaging business beginning in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, and we expect total revenue to decline in fiscal year 2027 compared to fiscal year 2026, as the anticipated decline in legacy customer revenue is expected to exceed the growth in AI customer revenue.
Over time, we expect AI customer revenue to represent an increasing share of total revenue.

At the same time, we are increasing our investment in sales and marketing to convert increased market awareness into pipeline, new AI customers and expansion within our installed base, which we expect to adversely affect our operating margins in the near term.
There can be no assurance that growth in AI customer revenue will offset the decline in legacy revenue within the timeframe we expect, or at all.

As of September 30, 2026, our remaining performance obligations were $71.2 million, of which we expect to recognize $51.9 million and $19.3 million as revenue within one year and beyond one year, respectively.

We expect SaaS revenue from legacy customers to continue to decline, and we expect growth in AI customer SaaS revenue to only partially offset this decline in fiscal year 2027.
We expect professional services revenue to fluctuate depending on the volume and completion of projects.
We expect revenue from AI customers to grow as we add new customers, expand our relationships within existing AI customers and migrate legacy customers to our current AI-enabled platform.

We expect revenue from legacy customers to continue to decline as customers migrate to our AI offerings or reduce or terminate their legacy arrangements, and as we wind down certain legacy offerings, including our legacy messaging business beginning in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027.

We expect sales and marketing expense to increase over fiscal year 2027 compared to fiscal year 2026, including costs associated with our Solve26 customer conference held in October 2026 and expanded industry-focused and partner go-to-market programs, as we invest to grow AI customer revenue.

We expect income from operations for fiscal year 2027 to be lower than fiscal year 2026, and we may incur operating losses in certain quarters, as revenue from legacy customers declines and we increase our investment in sales and marketing.
Based upon our current business plan, we believe that existing capital resources will enable us to maintain current and planned operations for at least the next 12 months.
